name: Market Woman
fantasy: Queen of her stall, knows every price and wholesaler in town.

perks.name: Price Memory
perks.text: Spot price trends one day ahead to buy stock at optimal rates.

perks.name: Regular Customers
perks.text: Repeat buyers pay 5% above standard street margins.

weakness: Physical fatigue sets in quickly on lengthy market days.

name: Pure-Water Seller
fantasy: Fast on foot, carrying ice-cold sachets through humid Oshodi traffic.

perks.name: Afternoon Rush
perks.text: Peak pure-water sales during sweltering afternoon blocks.

perks.name: Agile Steps
perks.text: Sprinting between danfo queues consumes 20% less Energy.

weakness: Rainy blocks decimate demand and chill sales figures.

name: Traffic Hawker
fantasy: Weaving between idling bumpers with plantain chips, biscuits, and bottled drinks.

perks.name: Gridlock Radar
perks.text: Earn bonus profit when severe traffic jams stall the expressway.

perks.name: Pocket Change
perks.text: Never short on change; rapid transactions prevent missed car sales.

weakness: Draws heightened Heat from environmental enforcement task forces.

name: Phone Accessories Dealer
fantasy: Chargers, powerbanks, tempered glass, and sharp electronic bargaining.

perks.name: Accessory Margin
perks.text: Small portable items offer massive 40% retail markup.

perks.name: Flawless Fitting
perks.text: Free installation service builds fast customer Respect.

weakness: Delicate inventory easily damaged during unexpected downpours or scuffles.

name: Foodstuff Wholesaler
fantasy: Bags of rice, beans, garri, and tubers moving in dependable bulk shipments.

perks.name: Bulk Supplier
perks.text: Purchase wholesale sacks at a 15% discount directly from depot trucks.

perks.name: Essential Commodity
perks.text: Food items never lose demand regardless of economic hardship.

weakness: High warehouse storage overhead and transport freight fees.

name: Mama Put
fantasy: Steaming pots of jollof, amala, and pepper soup drawing loyal neighbourhood queues.

perks.name: Aroma Magnet
perks.text: Satisfied patrons tip extra and boost neighbourhood Respect.

perks.name: Free Sustenance
perks.text: Personal daily food expenses are completely eliminated.

weakness: Requires daily gas/kerosene fuel and grueling pre-dawn market trips.

name: Danfo Driver
fantasy: Master of the iconic yellow bus, reigning over the fast lane and bus parks.

perks.name: Yellow Rush
perks.text: Completes passenger routes 1 time block faster during peak hours.

perks.name: Rugged Chassis
perks.text: Danfo resists engine breakdown damage from rough potholed roads.

weakness: Primary magnet for union ticket levies and checkpoint inspections.

name: Conductor
fantasy: Door-hanging voice of the bus, calling destinations and collecting fares on the fly.

perks.name: Resonant Call
perks.text: Fills empty passenger seats twice as fast at crowded bus stops.

perks.name: Fare Tracker
perks.text: Zero fare loss from passengers attempting to slip away without paying.

weakness: High physical stamina drain and minimal baseline capital.

name: Okada Rider
fantasy: Two-wheeled navigator squeezing through impossible traffic gridlocks.

perks.name: Alleyway King
perks.text: Bypasses traffic penalties and gridlock delays entirely.

perks.name: Emergency Fare
perks.text: Stranded commuters gladly pay double fares during downpours.

weakness: High road hazard risk and restricted expressway zones.

name: Keke Driver
fantasy: Steering the yellow tricycle through inner street routes and quiet estates.

perks.name: Inner Street Charm
perks.text: Earns higher Respect and safer travel in residential zones.

perks.name: Fuel Sipper
perks.text: Consumes 30% less fuel per run compared to full-sized buses.

weakness: Cannot carry heavy freight or access restricted highways.

name: Bus Park Chairman
fantasy: Commanding loading bays, arbitrating route schedules, and leading driver unions.

perks.name: Daily Union Dues
perks.text: Collects passive morning revenue from active loading bays.

perks.name: Chairman Respect
perks.text: Commands commanding Respect among all commercial drivers and touts.

weakness: High Heat accumulation from municipal regulators and union competitors.

name: Dispatch Rider
fantasy: Cargo box mounted, delivering urgent packages and online orders across the metropolis.

perks.name: Priority Orders
perks.text: Consistent stream of guaranteed parcel delivery gigs.

perks.name: Street Navigator
perks.text: Minimal chance of getting lost or held up looking for tricky addresses.

weakness: Hefty financial penalties for damaged parcels or late deliveries.
